description:
[Live DNS query audit. Read-only, non-destructive, side-effect free]. Resolves authoritative DNS records to audit SPF syntax (including recursive 10-lookup RFC limit check), DMARC policy enforcement, DKIM public key selectors, BIMI SVG certificates, MTA-STS mail security, and TLS-RPT reporting records.
Usage: Use this tool to evaluate email authentication and anti-spoofing posture for a domain. For general web HTTPS certificate inspection, use 'tls_http_inspector' instead.
Returns: JSON object with { domain: string, spf: { valid: boolean, lookupsCount: number, record: string }, dmarc: { valid: boolean, policy: string, record: string }, dkim: { found: boolean, selector: string }, bimi: object, mtaSts: object, deliverabilityScore: number, recommendations: string[] }.

selector.description: Optional DKIM selector (default probes google, default, k1, mail)

name: email_deliverability_audit
